name: model-effort-menu
title: Model Effort Menu
description: A chat's model and effort as quiet text that opens one compact menu: models with number shortcuts, an Effort submenu with only the chosen model's levels, and More models with the ones you can't use, muted.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing the model and effort for a chat, from its composer's meta line.
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent's default model in settings (Select or a settings form), or a list of many options that needs search (Combobox).
